blocks.text: Hyperthyroidism is a condition in which an overactive thyroid gland is producing an excessive amount of thyroid hormones that circulate in the blood. Graves' disease, multinodular goiter (TMNG), inflammation of the thyroid gland (thyroiditis) and excessive iodine intake are the most common cause of hyperthyroidism.

blocks.text: Following surgery for Toxic multinodular goiter, thyroid hormone replacement should be started at a dose appropriate for the patient’s weight (0.8µg/lb. or 1.7µg/kg) and age, with elderly patients needing somewhat less. blocks.text: Thyroid storm is one of the most life-threatening endocrine emergencies, resulting from exacerbation of manifestations of thyrotoxicosis.
